prompt: Oil painting of A close-up artistic composition of stacked cut firewood logs arranged tightly together, forming a rustic, natural mosaic pattern. Each log slice varies in size, shape, and tone, showing circular growth rings, subtle cracks, natural imperfections, and warm beige-to-golden wood textures. Soft, diffused lighting enhances the grain patterns and organic details. The logs are outlined by deep shadow gaps, creating contrast between the pale wood and the dark negative space. The overall aesthetic feels earthy, cozy, and tactile, reminiscent of cabin décor or Scandinavian minimalism. Add gentle texture for a handcrafted, painterly look. Render in high-resolution, warm tones, subtle vignetting, and a slightly matte, natural finish for wall art. --ar 2:3
